### ✨ Onmyoji Mod Menu (m0hammed) (v1.8.19)
Pro Glass UI Mod Menu by **m0hammed** (`@m0hmm3d`) — supports both **Rootless (`arm64`)** and **RootHide (`arm64e`)**.

### 🔥 Mod Features
- **God Mode (Invincible Allies)** — Allies take 0 damage and cannot die
- **Auto-Max Ally HP** — Keep ally HP locked at 100%
- **Ally MaxHP Multiplier** — Multiply ally maximum HP
- **Ally Defense Multiplier** — Multiply ally defense and reduce damage taken
- **Instant Full Heal Allies** — Restore all allies to 100% HP
- **1-Hit Kill Enemies** — Defeat enemies in a single hit
- **Outgoing Damage Multiplier** — Multiply all damage dealt by allies
- **Ally Attack Stat Multiplier** — Multiply ally attack power
- **100% Critical Hit** — All ally attacks critically hit
- **Ignore 100% Enemy Defense** — Bypass all enemy defense
- **Infinite Orbs (0 Skill Cost)** — Ally skills cost 0 orbs and orb bar stays full (8/8)
- **No Skill Cooldown** — All ally skills have 0 turn cooldown
- **Ally Speed Multiplier** — Multiply ally speed for faster turns
- **Max Orbs (8/8) & Reset Cooldowns** — Refill orb bar to max and reset all skill cooldowns
- **Freeze Enemy HP** — Enemies take 0 damage
- **Skip Skill Cutscenes** — Automatically skip skill animations
- **Instant Win Current Battle** — Win the current battle immediately
- **Global Game Speed** — Speed up gameplay and animations
- **Target Frame Rate (FPS)** — Set target frame rate (30 / 60 / 120 FPS)

### 🔒 License & Activation
- **1-User Device Lock**: Each token locks automatically to the first device that activates it.
- **Trial & Full Keys**: Supports `2h` trial keys, `30d` plans, and Lifetime keys.
- **Telegram Support & Keys**: Contact **@m0hmm3d** on Telegram.
